svg.textArea: Found by going through the winning video ads of ~250 brands doing $1M-$100M+/yr (Winning Hunter, Oct 2026). Only formats that are NOT already in the board on the left. Every example is a winner: Meta video ad running 30+ days and still live (late Sept 2026). Each clip loops the first 8 seconds silently right on the board; click 💾 Saved copy for the full ad with sound (permanent copy in your Google Drive), ▶ Ad Library for the live ad, WH for the Winning Hunter page.
